params.body:
## Why

Shane on a phone (about 390 px):

- Relaties: the search field at half width next to "Sorteer op", "+ Toevoegen" wrapped to a second line as an orphan. "moet zoekveld niet volledige breedte? wss toepasselijk voor vele pagina's met gelijkaardige layout."
- Offertes and Bestelbonnen: the filter row under the column headers collapsed into eight unnamed controls at about 60% width (Naam, Merk, Model, an amount box, "Alle", an empty select, a date, a lone eraser). "filter offertes niet gebruiksvriendelijk op mobiel."
- Transport: the "Acties" menu opened off the right edge, its three rows cut off after "als" and all three filled blue. "op mobiel transport acties niet zichtbaar."

He was right about the second half of the first remark: it is one pattern on many pages.

## The pages and how each is built

The header (search, sort, filter, add) and the filter row are **copied markup**, not a partial or a component. Twenty-one blades carry it, in three variants:

| Page | View | List | Header | Filter row | Add |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Relaties | `livewire/relations.blade.php` | Livewire | search (`ui-search`) + `ui-menu` sort + add | one search box, no row | toolbar |
| Offertes | `livewire/offers.blade.php` | Livewire | `.dropdown` sort + Filteren | `thead`, `wire:model` | none |
| Bestelbonnen, Testritten, Contracten, Historiek | `offertes/index*.blade.php` | classic | `.dropdown` sort + Filteren | `tbody` th cells, `ui-autofilter` form | none |
| Eigen handelaren | `merchants/index.blade.php` | classic | Filteren | `tbody`, autofilter | in the last header cell |
| Gebruikers | `settings/user/index.blade.php` | classic | `ui-menu` sort + Filteren + add | `thead`, autofilter | toolbar |
| Exports, Mijn aangeboden wagens | `export/index.blade.php`, `export/ongoing_won/index.blade.php` | classic | Filteren (ongoing_won: always-open row) | `tbody` | header cell |
| Dealers, rollen, locaties, opties, extra opties, vereisten, nuttige links, release notes, simple lists, locations tab | `settings/**/index.blade.php`, `simple/index.blade.php` | classic | Filteren | `thead` | header cell |
| Transport | `settings/transport/index.blade.php` + `header.blade.php` | classic | `.dropdown` sort + Filteren; Acties menu in the page head | `tbody` | none |
| Eigen wagenpark | `livewire/own-stock-list.blade.php` | Livewire | own `ui-list-header` (PR 343), untouched | filter panel | own |

Extracting the header once was weighed against the cutover being today: too large. The phone layout hangs on three shared classes and one media block instead, and the extraction is an open point.

## What changed once (shared)

`resources/css/refresh.css`, one media block at the end, plus two rules on every width:

- `ui-list-toolbar`: on a phone the search field takes the full width on its own row; sort and the primary action share the row below, sort left, add right. With three controls (sort, filter, add) sort and filter share the row and add takes a full row (German "Sortieren nach" does not fit three across at 390 px). A sort menu in the toolbar becomes a bottom sheet with a backdrop, PR 343's shape; `@click.self` on the wrapper closes it.
- `ui-list-filters`: the filter row becomes a panel behind the Filteren button. Each cell is full width with the **column name as a real label** (`data-label`, copied from the header row by the existing script in `layouts/app.blade.php` and `modalApp.blade.php`), empty cells disappear, and the clear button reads "Filters wissen" (`ui-filter-word`, hidden on desktop). The `thead` becomes a block too: it was not one, which is why the row sat at 60%.
- `ui-list-titled`: a list of people (relations, merchants, users) shows the name as the card heading, e-mail and phone as quiet lines without a repeated label, actions as a row below. Offers and orders keep "label: value", because there every column carries its own quantity (price, date, damage) and the label means something.
- Thirteen lists keep "+ Toevoegen" in the last column-header cell, which is hidden on a phone: that cell now stays visible as a full-width button above the cards until the markup moves to the toolbar.
- Every width: the `tbody` filter cells of the classic lists had no padding (they fell outside both the `thead th` and the `tbody td` rule), so the inputs touched; now the same padding as the cells. `button.ui-menu-item` gets a reset so a menu row may be a button.
- `ui-menu--sheet`: a page-head menu that becomes a sheet on a phone (used for Transport's Acties).

## What changed per page

- One class on the toolbar div (19 pages), one class on the filter row (18 rows), the words in the clear and search buttons, `@click.self` on the sort wrapper.
- `settings/user/index.blade.php`: the filter cells now stand under their own columns (the role select sat under "Naam", the name field under "E-mail").
- `livewire/offers.blade.php`, `offertes/indexOrders.blade.php`, `offertes/indexRentals.blade.php`: the "Aangemaakt door" select names itself in its first option instead of a blank box (and the duplicate empty pair from `getUsers()` is dropped, which also made the browser select the blank one).
- `settings/transport/header.blade.php`: the Acties menu was **broken on desktop as well, not only on a phone**: a Bootstrap `.dropdown-menu` without `dropdown-menu-right` on a button at the right edge, so it opened off screen on every width, and its items carried `btn btn-primary` next to `dropdown-item`, so all three status transitions (S4-10.11) read as the active choice. Now a `ui-menu` anchored to the right edge of its button, three plain rows, a sheet on a phone. Only the header partial was touched; `index.blade.php` belongs to the transport agent.
- `livewire/relations.blade.php`, `merchants/index.blade.php`, `settings/user/index.blade.php`: `ui-list-titled` on the table.

No behaviour change: same form names, same Livewire properties, same handlers.

## Docs and tests

- Rule R P1-1.16 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/31-p1-dagelijks-werk.md` (P1-1.15 was taken on main while this was in flight; renumbered).
- Findings as files (new procedure): `bevindingen/2026-09-15-lijstkop-en-filters-telefoon.md`, `bevindingen/2026-09-15-transport-acties-menu-buiten-beeld.md`. Open point: `open-punten/2026-09-15-lijstkop-markup-extractie.md`.
- `tests/Feature/ListPageHeadersTest.php` (`@rule P1-1.16`): the toolbar class on relations, offers, orders, merchants, rentals (rendered pages, `actingAsWithRights`); the filter row, the words in the clear button and no blank select on offers, orders, merchants, rentals; the users filter order; the transport Acties menu (ui-menu sheet, right-anchored, three plain rows, no btn-primary, all three transitions present).

## Open points

- The header and filter row as a component (`x-ui.list-toolbar`, `x-ui.list-filters`), so the next change is not 21 edits.
- "+ Toevoegen" out of the column-header cell into the toolbar on the thirteen pages that have it there.
- `settings/transport/index.blade.php` toolbar: `ui-list-toolbar` on the div and `@click.self` on the sort menu, once the transport agent is done there.
- The sort menus on offers/orders/rentals/contracts/history/transport are Bootstrap `.dropdown`, relations/users are `ui-menu`; both become a sheet, but it is two builds of one thing.
- On a phone the filter panel shows the column name twice (label plus the placeholder the script sets).

## Verified

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'Relation|Merchant|User|Offer|Order|Rental|OwnStockList|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|RulesCoverage|ListPageHeaders|OwnStockHeaderMenus|RulesDocsBuild|RulesIdentity'`: OK (149 tests, 1132 assertions). Full suite: 863 tests, 8 failures that also fail on origin/main in this environment (BuildStampTest, IntegrationSmokeTest x6, WarrantyPasswordTest; environment-bound, unrelated to this change).

Screenshots at 390 px (relations, offers with filters open, orders with filters open, merchants, transport with Acties open, relations with the sort sheet) and 1440 px (relations, orders with filters, transport with Acties); desktop pixel-diff against origin/main shows only anti-aliasing noise on rounded corners, plus the intended filter-cell gap and the Acties menu.
params.title: List page headers fit a phone
